message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"The backlog is growing because the notify-worker service is experiencing upstream rate limiting, causing delivery attempts to fail and messages to be retried multiple times, which prevents clearing the queue.","evidence_ids":["log:2","log:4","log:6"]},"missing_evidence":["logs showing successful message processing or other errors in notify-worker","metrics on processing rate or queue consumption"],"observations":[{"claim":"The notify-queue service logs show a rapidly growing queue depth, increasing from 184000 to 201000 messages between 17:20 and 17:49, with the oldest message age exceeding 3 hours.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:6"]},{"claim":"The notify-worker service logs contain multiple warnings about delivery attempt failures due to upstream returning HTTP 429 (rate limiting), with retries ongoing (e.g., retry 4 of 8 and retry 7 of 8).","evidence_ids":["log:2","log:4"]},{"claim":"The notify-worker service logs an error about metric read unavailability due to telemetry backend returning 503, indicating possible monitoring or telemetry issues.","evidence_ids":["log:7"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check upstream service rate limits and capacity to handle notification delivery requests.","Inspect notify-worker retry logic and backoff settings to prevent excessive retries causing backlog.","Verify telemetry backend health to restore metric visibility for better monitoring."]}
